source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enable HTTP BOOT on onboard NIC. Verify HTTP boot function from each NIC port.
1. In BIOS setup, verify that all the HTTP BOOT enabled NICs/LOMs show up in the boot sequence.
2. With on board NIC cards enabled, reboot the server and choose the HTTP BOOT option.
3. Select the NIC port from the list for HTTP BOOT boot.
4. Download efi from http server successfully.
5. Boot into grub.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. On board NIC ports should be shown in the boot sequence page when HTTP BOOT function is enabled

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- HTTP BOOT function test (IPv6): HTTP BOOT IPv6 boot test needs the operator to enable HTTP BOOT in BIOS, reboot, choose the HTTP BOOT option, download the efi from the HTTP server and boot into grub - a BIOS/boot-menu interactive flow the agent cannot drive from the OS.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator enables HTTP BOOT in BIOS, selects the option per NIC port, downloads the efi and boots into grub; agent cannot drive the pre-OS HTTP boot menu.

original_test_intent: Verify that each approved NIC presents an IPv6 HTTP Boot entry, downloads the exact EFI artifact over the intended IPv6 path and reaches GRUB.
original_method: An operator performs firmware enablement and per-port selection and observes GRUB; the agent validates the artifact and correlates isolated RA/DHCPv6/HTTP transactions to the selected MAC/port before restoration.
manual_activity: Firmware entry observation, NIC selection and EFI-to-GRUB handoff are manual acceptance steps; automation only validates artifact and IPv6 service evidence.
required_inputs: Isolated IPv6 RA/DHCPv6/HTTP services and fixed URL
Console/BMC access, reboot approval and restore plan
safety_requirements: Contain RA, DHCPv6 and HTTP responses within the test segment and pin the artifact hash.
Do not infer firmware or GRUB success from IPv6 address assignment or HTTP access alone.
Restore boot order, HTTP Boot and isolated service state.
Stop on wrong scope, artifact, port, target or console loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate IPv6 service/artifact readiness and collect RA/DHCPv6/HTTP transactions keyed by selected MAC/port, URL, bytes and hash.
Compare supporting evidence and health/restoration without operating firmware UI or issuing verdict.
engineer_actions: Enable IPv6 HTTP Boot, inspect and select each NIC entry, and attest EFI download plus GRUB handoff.
Restore settings/services and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The narrative correctly rejects OS automation as a substitute for pre-OS interaction.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only IPv6/NIC evidence, artifact hashing and isolated RA/DHCPv6/HTTP logs to support operator captures.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The IPv6 per-port EFI/GRUB scope and 40/40-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate console-observed firmware selection and GRUB handoff with the exact NIC's IPv6 discovery/configuration and fixed-artifact HTTP transfer.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Servers with UEFI IPv6 HTTP Boot support.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, NIC firmware, RA/DHCPv6/HTTP, EFI and GRUB versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform UEFI HTTP Boot documentation and approved IPv6 boot-service/artifact manifest.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds IPv6 control-plane isolation, exact object identity and transaction correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong RA/DHCPv6 scope, wrong URL/object and ordinary OS IPv6 traffic that does not prove firmware boot.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: NIC map, IPv6 service policy, URL and artifact hash.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Automated network evidence cannot replace the manual firmware entry and GRUB observations.

project_override_considerations: Projects may choose address-discovery method, ports and EFI image, but completion is limited to the declared service path, artifact hash and tested ports.
expected_evidence: NIC map, isolated IPv6 service readiness and exact artifact hash
Correlated RA/DHCPv6 and HTTP transfer record
Restored boot/network state and health logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently specifies IPv6 HTTP Boot; the shorter criterion does not negate the Procedure's download and GRUB requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The flow is clear and operator-executable; acceptance remains MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the manual boundary and adds IPv6 artifact and containment controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its IPv6-specific correlation and restoration design.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent evidence support, execution and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Ensures that IPv6 configuration or an arbitrary HTTP response is not mistaken for a verified boot of the approved EFI into GRUB.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case joins an interactive firmware decision with IPv6 service negotiation, exact file transfer and visible GRUB execution; only the service evidence is automatable, so the acceptance core stays manual.
